main_text.p: donibus sibi vim illatam, si poffet, etiam repellere vellet; respondisse. Quid ni, securè su-Bulluæs.[?] merem gladium, instar alicujus judicis, ac me putarem bonum opus perfecisse. disp.1.de tribus gener- Probatur 4. ex legeJur. Præ-cept. Exod.c. 22.v.2.3. Mosis, in quâ cautum, si fur domum effregerit, & in ipso facto deprehensus, accepto vulnere mortuus fuerit, percussorem non fore sanguinis reum. Vt ipse Deus tutelæ inculpatæ moderamen observari voluerit. Nam in ipso facto deprehensum, & armatum furem occidere fas esse judicat, quod discerni nequeat, an venerit animo occidendi, an vero furandi animo.

Displicet tamen sententia illa jurisconsultorum: latronem insidiantem licere occidere, nonnullis ecclesiasticis scriptoribus. Ita enim Antistes Hipponensis. Legem, inquit, quidem non reprehendo, quæ tales permittit interfici, sed quomodo istos, quiAugust. libr.1. de liber.Arbitr. c.5.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "su-" in "securè su-merem" is read as su- (sumerem), the scan looks like fu- at the line end. The marginal note "Bulluæs." is uncertain; the printed form may differ. Long s is written as plain s. The ff/ss ligature in "respondisse" and "posset" is rendered as ss. The last word "qui" is a catchword and not part of the text. The printed note block "gener-" and "Jur. Præ-cept." sits beside the lines as shown; exact line alignment of the notes is approximate.
